item.title: Neovim Distributions in 2026: LazyVim vs NvChad vs AstroNvim — Which One Should You Actually Run?
item.description: You install Neovim 0.11, open it, and get a blinking cursor and nothing else. No file tree, no completion, no fuzzy finder, no LSP. That blank screen is the reason nearly 70,000 people have starred one of three preconfigured Neovim distributions instead of writing their own init.lua from scratch.
